name: Anniversary Cake
desc: Drenched in blue glaze and stuck with candles, this glow tulip chocolate cake marks a special anniversary.

name: Fruit Bread
desc: A traditionally baked fruit bread with powdered sugar on top. One slice is never enough!

name: Winter Dinner
desc: A full meal to warm your belly in the cold season. Prepared with a roasted larva, hot heartberry sauce, dumplings and some greens.

name: Caveling Bread
desc: Dry, hard bread. It feels like chewing chalk but fills the stomach.

name: Bloat Oat
desc: A handful of healthy cereal that fills you up and gives you energy.

name: Slushie
desc: An ice cold beverage with a kick of flavor. May cause a slight chill.

name: Golden Bloat Oat
desc: A very rare variant of the common bloat oat.

name: Kelp Dumpling
desc: A soft, warm dumpling that smells pretty... funny. You don't really want to know where that one came from.

name: Cave Crunch
desc: A chunky, sweet snack in a wrapper. Must be thousands of years old and probably still edible for a couple more.

name: Tentacle Jerky
desc: A dried piece of tentacle. It's quite tough and keeps your teeth busy.

name: Giant Mushroom
desc: The king of all mushrooms. Growing in perfect conditions made it unusually large.

name: Atlantean Worm Heart
desc: This is but one of the many hundred hearts of the Atlantean Worm that give it the strength to hurl its gigantic body through the water. Therefore it brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

name: Lunar Cheese
desc: An aromatic snack that seems out of this world. Is it proof that the moon is made out of cheese after all?

name: Oblidra's Heart
desc: This still beating heart of the Void Lord pulses inward rather than outward. It brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

name: Marbled Meat
desc: A thick slab of meat, waiting to be simmered and seasoned.

name: Shiny Larva Meat
desc: Rare, golden variant of larva meat, with increased effects.

name: Food Ration
desc: Canned meal made to last for years. You should look for better food options soon.

name: Larva Meat
desc: Only true survivors eat it raw.

name: Amber Larva
desc: Grub encapsulated in amber, an extremely rare ingredient.

name: Vit
desc: A grape-flavored soda.

name: Meadow Milk
desc: A bottle of milk with a slight vanilla aroma and an earthy aftertaste.

name: Grumpkin
desc: A lumpy fruit that looks very annoyed with having been pulled from the soil.

name: Blue Cave Guppy
desc: Small, blue fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

name: Rock Jaw
desc: A small shark that can break almost every material with one bite.

name: Dagger Fin
desc: The scales of this fish are thin like razorblades.

name: Pink Palace Fish
desc: A pink, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

name: Teal Palace Fish
desc: A greenish-blue, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

name: Vampire Eel
desc: A bloodsucking fish latching onto everything that has a pulse.

name: Rot Fish
desc: Half of its body is missing but somehow it's still alive. Creepy.

name: Silver Dart
desc: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of blinking silver to confuse predators.

name: Golden Dart
desc: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of flickering gold to confuse predators.

name: Pink Coralotl
desc: A small pink amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

name: Solid Spikeback
desc: A very defensive fish with rock-hard skin and sharp spikes protruding out.

name: Brown Dune Tail
desc: This brown, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

name: Litho Trilobite
desc: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its gray shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

name: Greenhorn Pico
desc: This little green creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

name: Glowing Mushroom
desc: A bitter, pungent mushroom that brightens up murky caves.

name: Rootbear
desc: This soda tastes like licorice, or something worse.

name: Dodo Egg
desc: A large egg protected by an ivory shell. Safe for consumption!

name: Pewpaya
desc: A juicy, sweet fruit that clears your mind and raises focus.

name: Pinegrapple
desc: An intensely tasty fruit that has you clench your weapons tightly.

name: Golden Pewpaya
desc: A very rare variant of the common pewpaya.

name: Golden Pinegrapple
desc: A very rare variant of the common pinegrapple.

name: Glazed Heart Berry
desc: A sugar-covered heart berry that's still juicy and fresh underneath. Delicious!

name: Orange Cave Guppy
desc: Small, orange fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

name: Gem Crab
desc: This rare crab has ancient gemstones growing all over it.

name: Crown Squid
desc: All hail the pale king of water!

name: Yellow Blister Head
desc: A fish with large yellow bubbles on its head.

name: Green Blister Head
desc: A fish with large green bubbles on its head.

name: Devil Worm
desc: A hellspawn that dwells in the sea ground. Don't step on it.

name: Mold Shark
desc: A small predator of the murky mold waters.

name: Black Steel Urchin
desc: A rare sea critter with spikes as hard as steel.

name: Azure Feather Fish
desc: A beautiful blue fish with scales that look like feathers.

name: Emerald Feather Fish
desc: A beautiful green fish with scales that look like feathers.

name: Astral Jelly
desc: Extremely rare type of jellyfish. It almost feels out of this world.

name: Bottom Tracer
desc: A bright yellow fish with long barbels that it drags along the sea floor in search for food.

name: Sandy Spikeback
desc: A very defensive fish with sandstone skin and jagged spikes protruding out.

name: Gray Dune Tail
desc: This gray, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

name: Tornis Kingfish
desc: An extremely rare enigma of sea life that seems to unify all other fish beneath it.

name: Dark Lava Eater
desc: A dark fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

name: Bright Lava Eater
desc: A bright fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

name: Verdant Dragonfish
desc: This draconic fish has green scales that can withstand remarkably high temperatures.

name: Starlight Nautilus
desc: A mysterious living fossil that seems to have fused with precious metals and gemstones to ascend to a higher state of being.

name: Beryll Angle Fish
desc: This moon-blue fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

name: Glistening Deepstalker
desc: A crystal-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

name: Splendid Deepstalker
desc: A Solarite-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

name: Pinkhorn Pico
desc: This little pink creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

name: Riftian Lampfish
desc: An extraordinary creature that doesn't seem to be from this world. Its biology works entirely different from anything you know.

name: Mushroom
desc: A small cave mushroom, perfect for a snack on the go.

name: Skip
desc: A well-preserved sugar cookie.

name: Heart Berry
desc: A sweet, juicy berry that refreshes the body.

name: Golden Heart Berry
desc: A very rare variant of the common heart berry.

name: Golden Grumpkin
desc: A very rare variant of the common grumpkin.

name: Golden Chocolate
desc: A limited edition chocolate for the cold season. There is no golden ticket inside, instead the whole thing is made out of it!

name: Spirit Veil
desc: A ghastly fish that floats in the air like it's still underwater.

name: White Coralotl
desc: A small white amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

name: Elder Dragonfish
desc: A draconic fish that is several hundred years old. The verdant color of its scales has long faded.

name: Cosmic Form
desc: A strange entity that is unlike any terrestrial sea life you have ever seen. Did it come from a place far away from earth?

name: Jasper Angle Fish
desc: This sun-golden fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

name: Terra Trilobite
desc: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its brown shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

name: Rainbow Kelp
desc: A super rare mutation of common kelp, showing off a variety of colors.

name: Carrock
desc: Rock-hard vegetable that toughens you up.

name: Sunrice
desc: A vibrant crop that braces you for tough encounters.

name: Golden Sunrice
desc: A very rare variant of the common sunrice.

name: Golden Lunacorn
desc: A very rare variant of the common lunacorn.

name: Box of Chocolates
desc: These chocolates come in a nice gift box and are mouth and heart melting.

name: Lunacorn
desc: A mealy, colorful crop that increases your toughness.

name: Golden Carrock
desc: A very rare variant of the common carrock.

name: Winter Cookies
desc: Nicely decorated this handful of cookies will put one in a seasonal mood. There's even a little core-shaped one in there.

name: Bomb Pepper
desc: A fierce vegetable for spicing up foods.

name: Puffungi
desc: A moldy fungus fit for gourmets.

name: Golden Bomb Pepper
desc: A very rare variant of the common bomb pepper.

name: Golden Puffungi
desc: A very rare variant of the common puffungi.

name: Chewy Cone Candy
desc: A super sweet candy that ends up in the gap of your teeth. And it's there to stay.

name: Spooky Pop Candy
desc: It looks almost too scary to remove its wrapper. What tasty horrors might await behind?

name: Evil Eye Candy
desc: The most wicked creation of all, its taste an insult to the living. Black licorice.

name: Green Kelp
desc: A green lump of marine plants.

name: Gray Kelp
desc: A gray lump of marine plants.

name: Yellow Kelp
desc: A yellow lump of marine plants.

name: Pale Kelp
desc: A pale lump of marine plants.

name: Red Kelp
desc: A red lump of marine plants.

name: Blue Kelp
desc: A blue lump of marine plants.

name: Flesh Kelp
desc: A flesh-colored lump of marine plants.

name: Dark Blue Kelp
desc: A dark blue lump of marine plants.

name: Glow Tulip
desc: A precious, shimmering flower that absorbed ancient energy.

name: Golden Glow Tulip
desc: A very rare variant of the common glow tulip.

name: Crystal Kelp
desc: A crystallized lump of marine plants.

name: Pet Pellet
desc: This handful of treats with different meaty flavors is a great addition to your pets' diet.

name: Rare Candy
desc: A nutrient-rich snack that's highly sought after. Your pets will go crazy over this!

name: Beast Booster
desc: Fully packed with vitamins, flavors and lots of energy, this treat is the pinnacle of how you can spoil your pets.

name: Mug of Coffee
desc: A highly caffeinated drink. Sure to knock some fatigue off.

name: Kizz Cola
desc: A strange soda, from a strange vending machine.

name: Healing Potion
desc: A healthy elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes good.

name: Enrage Potion
desc: A strong elixir that buffs your muscles and your temper.

name: Stoneskin Potion
desc: A salty elixir that hardens your skin and makes you more resilient.

name: Poison Aid Potion
desc: A purple, mucky liquid that tastes horrible but cures any poison.

name: Greater Healing Potion
desc: A much healthier elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes great.

name: Keen Potion
desc: A cold elixir that focuses your senses and aim.

name: Guardian's Potion
desc: A potion that fills you with great courage and the ability to withstand the strongest of foes.

name: Cave Coffee
desc: A strong, bottled brew made from unknown ingredients. After ingesting it's hard for you to stand still.

name: Heart Berry Soda
desc: This canned sparkly drink is a pure explosion of taste and sweetness in your mouth.

name: Crystal Water
desc: Crystal clear water that has been filtered through ancient gemstones.

name: Unusual Potion
desc: A two-component potion that is risky to drink.

name: Splendid Amalgam
desc: A boiling-hot metallic fluid that merges with the bodies' cells after consumption, making them more resilient.

name: Arcane Potion
desc: A volatile concoction that amplifies your magical energy.

name: Pact of Power Potion
desc: An ominous looking liquid that elevates the power of your summoned forces.

name: Giant Mitochondrion
desc: This supersized organelle is a real powerhouse.

name: Burn Resistance Potion
desc: Dousing yourself with this elixir makes you flame retardant. Fire may still hurt, but it won't linger.

name: Mana Potion
desc: A potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes sweet.

name: Greater Mana Potion
desc: A very potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes syrupy.

name: Jingle Jam Cookie
desc: A special gift for participating in the Jingle Jam charity event.

name: Hot Punch
desc: Sitting down with this nice beverage will send a shiver of cozyness down ones spine. It's spicy, fruity and simply tasty.

name: Hot Chocolate
desc: A mug full of creamy, hot chocolate milk with small marshmallows on top. Drinking it feels like being a kid again.

name: Distilled Love
desc: This beverage made from rare pink slime tastes like cotton sugar and makes your heart flutter.

name: Paradise Fruit Basket
desc: A pure explosion of flavors enters your mouth when biting into these fruits.
